purpose: Economic modeling and simulation toolkit for AFI Protocol
droidGuidelines: This is a research/tooling repo, not production logic
All simulations must be deterministic (use seeded RNG from utils/rng.ts)
All simulations must be config-driven (read from JSON configs)
Do NOT implement full economic models unless explicitly asked
Keep stubs minimal and clearly marked with TODO comments
Outputs should be JSON/CSV for charting and analysis
Do NOT duplicate logic from afi-core, afi-token, or afi-reactor
Python notebooks are for experimentation only, not production

relatedRepos.afi-token: Smart contracts - afi-econ models inform contract parameters
relatedRepos.afi-core: Protocol interfaces - afi-econ simulates economic outcomes
relatedRepos.afi-reactor: Signal processing - afi-econ models signal flow economics
relatedRepos.afi-math: Pure math functions - afi-econ uses for calculations

commonTasks.addNewSimulation: Create model in src/models/, add command in src/cli/commands/, add default config in src/configs/defaults/
commonTasks.addPythonNotebook: Create .ipynb in python/notebooks/, mirror TS model logic in python/sims/
